INSERT INTO rb_notification (team_id, kind, source_id, actor, data)
            SELECT tk.team_id, $2::SMALLINT, $1::INT, $3::INT,
                jsonb_build_object(
                    'ticket_id', tk.id,
                    'message_id', $1,
                    'puzzle_id', p.id,
                    'puzzle_title', p.title
                )
            FROM rb_ticket tk
            LEFT JOIN rb_puzzle p ON p.id = tk.puzzle_id
            WHERE tk.id = $4
